Overview.Name: Ms. Jatan Nagda
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Managing diabetes, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction

Meal_1: Option 1: Paneer bhurji (120 g) + vegetable curry
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (~150 g) + paneer cubes (80 g)
Meal_2 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (150 g) & paneer curry (120 g) & vegetable curry + curd
Option 2: Chapati (2) & paneer bhurji (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (150 g) & mixed vegetable curry + paneer cubes (120 g)

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid sweets, sugar-sweetened beverages and fruit juices.
Do not stay hungry for long periods as it can worsen cravings and blood sugar control.
Get 20–30 minutes of morning sunlight exposure daily.
Aim for a short walk after the main meal to improve blood sugar management.
Improving sleep duration will significantly help diabetes management and fat loss.
Manage stress eating with hydration, walking and yoga before reaching for snacks.
